# Drawlib Architecture

> Internal architecture specification of Drawlib — layered engine (l1–l4), AST caching, multi-target doc compiler, CLI, and developer tooling.

## Overview

- [Architecture Overview](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/): Drawlib is a pure-Python library and compiler toolset designed for "Illustration as Code" and "Illustrated Documentation as Code". Unlike GUI diagram editors…

## 1. Overview & Architecture

- [System Architecture](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/01_overview/01_system_architecture.html): Drawlib is engineered from the ground up as a pure-Python illustration, slide, and documentation compilation framework. It eliminates the divide between…
- [Layer Hierarchy](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/01_overview/02_layer_hierarchy.html): A full-featured illustration and document compiler combines geometry math, font metrics, raster image pipelines, stateful Matplotlib rendering, auto-layout…

## 2. Core Engine

- [Canvas & Geometry](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/02_core_engine/01_canvas_and_geometry.html): At the core of Drawlib sits the Canvas Engine (_core/l4_canvas), which abstracts Matplotlib figures, patches, and physical DPI scaling behind a deterministic…
- [Types & Style Models](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/02_core_engine/02_types_and_styles.html): In traditional plotting libraries, styles are passed as untyped dictionaries ({"color": "blue", "lw": 2}), allowing silent key typos or out-of-range values…
- [Cache & AST Engine](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/02_core_engine/03_caching_and_ast_engine.html): Re-executing hundreds of Matplotlib scripts on every edit would turn documentation builds into multi-minute bottlenecks. Drawlib eliminates redundant…

- [Graph Auto-Layout](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/03_domain_subsystems/03_graph_autolayout.html): Visualizing cloud topologies, data pipelines, and hierarchical networks manually requires computing dozens of (x, y) coordinates, container envelopes, and…
- [Animation & Slide Engines](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/03_domain_subsystems/04_animation_and_slide_engines.html): Technical architecture communication rarely stops at static prose diagrams: engineers also need step-by-step animated state transitions and 16:9 presentation…

- [Multi-Target Exporters](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/04_doc_builder_and_compiler/02_multi_target_exporters.html): Enterprise engineering teams consume technical knowledge across fundamentally different mediums: interactive documentation portals, 16:9 architecture review…
